_meta.target_name: Broad substrate specificity ATP-binding cassette transporter ABCG2 (BCRP)
_meta.method: bio-research ChEMBL MCP (compound_search -> get_bioactivity vs CHEMBL5393). has_activity=true when >=1 documented ABCG2 bioactivity (inhibition) record exists; best_pchembl = max pChEMBL among records.
_meta.expanded: 2026-07-14 — added the three surviving docking candidates (rosuvastatin, vorinostat, avacopan) to close the Axis-2-thin gap flagged at import. All three returned 0 ChEMBL ABCG2 records.
_meta.known_limitation_substrate_blind_spot: This bounded ChEMBL activity check is not a transporter-substrate catalog. Rosuvastatin is independently identified as a BCRP substrate in the FDA CRESTOR label despite returning no ChEMBL ABCG2 activity row here. Substrate and broader transporter-relationship exclusions therefore require separate sources.
_meta.note: Populated for controls + surviving Axis-1 docking candidates. Molecules absent here were not individually queried; their known_inhibitor_flag (curated role_tag) still applies.

ivacaftor.note: 0 ABCG2 records; CFTR corrector, not a known ABCG2 ligand (specificity check)

novobiocin.note: 7 records, action_type INHIBITOR, IC50 25-85 uM (weak but documented ABCG2 inhibitor)

elacridar.note: IC50 410 nM, potent ABCG2 inhibitor (reference negative control)

rosuvastatin.substrate_source: FDA CRESTOR label 2026, section 12.3: rosuvastatin is a BCRP and OATP1B1 substrate; https://www.accessdata.fda.gov/drugsatfda_docs/label/2026/021366s047lbl.pdf
rosuvastatin.note: No ABCG2 activity record was found in this bounded ChEMBL check. The FDA label independently identifies rosuvastatin as a BCRP substrate, so it is excluded from this no-known-ABCG2-relationship screen.

vorinostat.note: 0 ChEMBL ABCG2 inhibition records. HDAC inhibitor; scattered literature reports HDAC inhibitors as ABCG2 substrates, but no ChEMBL inhibition record and no canonical clinical ABCG2-substrate designation. Remains the sole marginal 'uncertain' docking hit (margin +0.55); not disqualified by Axis 2, but its fold-selectivity margin is within Vina noise.

avacopan.note: 0 ChEMBL ABCG2 inhibition records. C5aR1 antagonist; the #1 raw fold-site binder (fold_q141k -7.82) but margin only +0.28 — did NOT reach the 'uncertain' tier. No known ABCG2 relationship.
